name: Cleaning Table and Fish Products
description: Cut big fish with a knife; scraps, meal, oil, roe and shark skin.

pages.title: Cleaning Table and Fish Products
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Lay a fish on the **Cleaning Table** and cut it with a **knife**.
- Heavier fish take more strokes and give more: fillets, steaks, roe, bones, scraps.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A **Deployer** with a knife works it; hoppers and funnels empty it.
- Scraps become **Fish Meal** and **Fish Oil**.
Three smooth stone slabs over logs and andesite alloy. Any knife works.

Right-click the table with a fish to lay it on, then cut with a knife. The fish lies there as itself; look at it to see the strokes done.\
\
Strokes: two for a minnow, five at 3 kg, sixteen at 50 kg. The parts go to you.

**What a fish gives**, by weight:

- raw **fillets**: about 3 from 1 kg, 8 from 10 kg
- from 3 kg, most of those are Hybrid Aquatic **fish steaks**
- **bones**: 1, plus 1 per 4 kg (up to 8)
- **Fish Scraps**: 1 plus more with weight (up to 10)

- **roe**, 4 times in 10, from sturgeon, salmon, herring and carp
- **shark skin** from sharks

Oily fish (salmon, herring, mackerel, tuna, anchovy, trout) give half again as many scraps.\
\
A fish without a weight on it counts as a usual one of its size class.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Automated.** A [#](2E5AAC)[Deployer](entry://create_basics/deployer)[#]() holding a knife cuts the fish. Then the parts wait in the table's output for hoppers or funnels, and the table takes the next fish once it is empty. See [#](2E5AAC)[Moving Items](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]().\
\
For a fish line, the [#](2E5AAC)[Fish Cleaner](entry://fishing/fish_cleaner)[#]() cleans only the big fish and passes the rest on.

pages.title: Fish Scraps
pages.text: Cut bait on a rod. A millstone or crushing wheels turn one into 1 Fish Meal, sometimes 2. Aquaculture's fish bones mill into Fish Meal and bone meal.

pages.title: Fish Meal
pages.text: For Boilies, Chum and feeding an Aquarium Tank. See [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]().

pages.title: Fish Oil
pages.text: [#](7A3C9A)[Compacting](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() 4 Fish Scraps, or one small oily fish, gives 100 mB. It heats a Blaze Burner from a pipe and runs the Fuel Reel Drive.

pages.title: Fish Roe
pages.text: Food, restoring 2 hunger points. From roe fish at the Cleaning Table.

pages.title: Shark Skin
pages.text: Smoke it, or cook it on a campfire, into leather.
